verdict.rationale: TruffleHog is open-source, installable via brew/Docker as a standalone binary, and docs explicitly offer a self-hosted deployment option ('Choose hosted... or self-hosted (running in your environment)'), corroborated by hands-on CLI installation and execution without needing an account or API key. missing for 10: independent third-party account of running the full self-hosted scanner+web-UI stack (not just the CLI) in production.
